text:
amelia: Heads-up — CI fuzz run uploaded a big batch of crash artifacts but the scanner metadata decrypt failed, looks like evidence is effectively orphaned. filing here so we can triage quickly
raj: ugh. which pipeline and where did it land?
amelia: nightly-fuzz-3, artifacts in s3://redwood-fuzz-results/2026-03-20/run-418/ ; scanner tried to decrypt at ingestion and logged KMS AccessDenied. full error: 
```
Error: AccessDeniedException: Caller not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01
 at ingest/fuzz-processor:v2
```
olivia: sec-bot posted an alert earlier: "fuzz-evidence: ingest failed (KMS Decrypt)" with alert id ALERT-2026-1142 :eyes:
sec-bot: automated-note: alert ALERT-2026-1142 created by fuzz-ingest; severity=medium; affected-artifacts=72; suggested-action=check keystore grants and svcaccount role.
marc: who owns the keystore? I thought fuzz-ingest uses the infra-fuzz service account which should have kms:Decrypt on that key.
raj: infra-fuzz-sa is in the fuzz-ingest IAM role, but there was an RBAC change yesterday — pmc-keystore-team rotated a grant and added a condition limiting via tag:project=fuzz. maybe the artifacts are uploaded without that tag.
jen: I can run a quick decrypt test from the ingest pod. give me 5m.
amelia: thanks. also we need to preserve evidence for forensics and compliance — do not delete the S3 objects.
jen: ran: `kubectl exec -n ingest deploy/fuzz-processor -- aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb:///tmp/test.cipher --query Plaintext --output text | base64 --decode` and got AccessDenied as well.
raj: okay confirmed. more details from audit log: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-21T00:00:00Z` shows Decrypt calls rejected with ConditionCheckFailed where a StringEquals tag:project check failed.
olivia: remediation options: 1) rollback tag condition on key policy (fast, org-impact), 2) add tag to artifacts at upload time (requires CI change + backfill), 3) grant temporary principal permission via ephemeral role for triage (least blast).
marc: recommend ephemeral role for triage so we can decrypt now and audit. we should also run a one-off backfill to re-run ingest with correct tags.
amelia: agree. designate owner for ephemeral grant + audit entries and who will run backfill.
jen: I can own the backfill (rerun ingest CLI against the S3 keys). estimate 2-3 hours to process 72 artifacts.
raj: I can coordinate with keystore team to create a short-lived grant for `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/fuzz-ingest-ephemeral` valid for 4 hours. will ask them to log the grant with request id.
olivia: add a compliance note for retention: evidence must be immutable until triage closed. Also we need an entry in the security runbook describing this failure mode and a CI unit test that asserts artifacts include `project:fuzz` tag before upload.
sec-bot: automated-note: created ticket SEC-2026-221: "orphaned-fuzz-artifacts - KMS tag mismatch" assigned to raj; severity=medium; SLA=48h.
marc: small long-term fix: change ingest to sign and include project metadata inside the encrypted payload (so key policy can be simpler) and add a preflight check on upload. plus add a nightly assertion job that decrypts a sample artifact.
amelia: agreed. immediate action items: (1) raj -> request ephemeral grant + post audit ref (2) jen -> run decrypt backfill and attach decrypted metadata to ticket (3) marc -> add runbook PR for KMS ingest failures (4) olivia -> add CI test for artifact tagging.
jen: starting backfill now, will post log link in SEC-2026-221 when done.
raj: pinging keystore team now: @keystore-team can you please approve ephemeral role for fuzz-ingest-ephemeral (4h) and confirm audit logging?
keystore-team (via keystore-team): acknowledged, will provision and post grant ARN. audit trail will include request id KGRANT-7892.
amelia: thanks all. once backfill completes we'll decide whether to block merges for fuzz-related pipelines until tagging coverage is fixed. for now keep running but mark triage as required on merges touching fuzz-libs. :memo:
marc: will draft the merge gating proposal in the infra repo and link it here.
sec-bot: automated-note: thread closed by sec-bot after owner assignment.
